name: code2flow-answer-flow-questions
title_zh: 对着扫描图问路，答你从A到B怎么走
tagline_zh: 不开画布，直接问机器可读的流程图：哪个屏是死胡同、PRD和代码哪里打架、箭头背后藏着什么。
tagline_en: Skip the canvas. Ask the scanned graph: dead ends, PRD-vs-code conflicts, what's behind an arrow. Every answer.
desc_en: Answer questions about a scanned app's user flows from Code2Flow's machine-readable outputs — "how does a user get from A to B", "which screens are unreachable or dead ends", "where does the PRD disagree with the code", "what is behind this arrow" — with file:line evidence and confidence, without opening the canvas. Use after `code2flow run`/`scan` has produced `<repo>/.code2flow/graph.json`.
why_zh: 把 Code2Flow 的 graph.json 变成可盘问的证人，而不是一张只能看的图。答案带出处。
why_en: Turns graph.json into an interrogable witness, not a static picture. Answers cite sources, admit uncertainty, and beat.
limit_zh: 只认 Code2Flow 生成的 graph.json，且必须先跑过 code2flow run/scan。
limit_en: Only works on Code2Flow's graph.json after a run/scan. No Figma source, no diagram drawing, no business semantics—just answers about relations.
title_en: Ask your scanned app graph how to get from A to B
